ChangeNotes.Value:
v3.5.0 - their real answer, every time: weighed with their heart in one breath, on lighter prompts and the new GPT-6 models.
TRUER, LIGHTER REPLIES * Fixed: when a character weighed their feelings mid-reply, their real answer was thrown away and a stray afterthought kept - the answer you get is the one they meant * Feelings are weighed together with every answer in one go - no extra wait, and no more drifting warmer with every letter they write unprompted * About a quarter fewer words sent with every reply - faster answers, cheaper on paid keys * A reply that came back as only its voice note keeps the words spoken a moment earlier * Letters no longer carry the spoken voice note * The world-tone setting no longer repeats itself; news of a castle that changed hands twice is told once
MODELS * GPT-6: the default is now gpt-6-luna (half the price of 5.6 Luna); Codex defaults to the new gpt-6.1-sol, which OpenRouter offers too; Astra joins the lists. Your chosen model is kept * A model that insists on thinking a little is asked for its lightest setting instead of being turned away * The ChatGPT-plan road no longer slips your own Codex instructions to the characters, and renews an expired sign-in by itself
ALSO * A letter to someone who has since joined you is handed over when you open the talk screen by its hotkey too * Developer mode: step a character's traits from the talk screen's Dev panel
Full history: https://github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
